brief.goal: Rebuild this page as the site's listing: which puppies are available today, who their parents are, and the three steps from a first message to collection day — so a reader can go from 'which one' to 'reserved' without leaving the page, and so the machine-readable version of 'this dog, this price, still available' lives here and nowhere else.
brief.scope: Ten sections: hero, the three-figure counter strip, the six-puppy grid, the parents, the three buying steps, collection and delivery, one review, a five-row FAQ, the enquiry form and the close. All seven migrated images at their original paths; data/facts/buy-blue-staffy-puppies-uk.json records no embed for this page and none is placed.

strategy.name: the listing
strategy.why: Four scanned pages list Staffordshire Bull Terrier puppies and not one marks a single dog up as a Product with an Offer — the closest of them puts eleven named puppies at £1,000 each on the page with no Product node anywhere, and the two classifieds mark up the page rather than the advert.
